:::{#exm-subset}
#### Even die rolls

The even die rolls form a subset of the possible rolls:
$\set{2, 4, 6} \subseteq \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
because each of $2$, $4$, and $6$ is a possible roll.
The set $\set{2, 4, 7}$ is not a subset of $\set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
because $7$ is not a possible roll.

:::
